title: Credential Synchronizer + Unified Retry DSL and async streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Multiple customer integrations observed subtle races between token refresh heartbeats and stream reconnect logic across our SDKs. The work unifies a lightweight credential synchronizer, introduces a small DSL for declarative retry profiles, and polishes async streaming ergonomics (cancellation semantics, typed stream guards, and clearer session priming). Summary of changes: 1) credential synchronizer: a cross-language thin coordinator that serializes credential refreshes, emits telemetry hooks (cred.refresh.start/stop/failure) and exposes an opt-in prefetch window to reduce hot-path latency on reconnect; 2) unified retry DSL: a compact, declarative retry profile language (backoff caps, jitter classes, idempotency predicates) compiled to per-SDK presets—used to standardize behavior for stream reconnects and the token refresh backoff; 3) streaming ergonomics: explicit cancel() semantics for pull/push streams, a StreamGuard type that enforces single-consumer and typed chunk envelopes, and improved handshake timeout defaults; 4) version bumps: python-sdk v2.8.0, typescript-sdk v1.27.0, go-sdk v1.4.2 to align APIs; 5) tests & docs: e2e sims for credential contention, new examples in quickstarts, and updated changelogs. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-1122) - [x] Backwards-compatible API (opt-in synchronizer) - [x] Unit tests added for all SDKs - [x] E2E stability test added to perf-canary harness - [x] Updated quickstart examples and CHANGELOGs How to exercise locally: follow the README in sdk-integration/test-harness: run `make multi-sdk-stream-e2e` which spins lightweight local servers and a token-mint stub. Rollout plan: feature gated; default off for existing customers. Staged rollout: enable for internal canary -> beta customers -> GA. Rationale: reduces duplicate refresh calls and transient 401s on bursty workloads while making retry semantics auditable and adjustable per workload.
commits: 1) Add credential-synchronizer core + telemetry hooks (a6b3f2e) 2) Retry DSL parser and presets, compile target for each SDK (b1c4d9a) 3) TS SDK ergonomics: StreamGuard and cancelable async generator adapter (c3d5f10) 4) Py SDK: session priming, prefetch window + context-manager semantics (d4e6a21) 5) Go SDK: lightweight synchronizer shim and typed envelope (e5f7b32) 6) Tests: multi-sdk e2e harness + unit tests (f6g8h43) 7) Docs/CHANGELOG updates and version bumps (g7h9i54)

release_notes: Introduce opt-in credential synchronizer to reduce duplicate token refreshes on bursty workloads; add a declarative retry DSL with presets for stream reconnects; expose StreamGuard and explicit cancel() semantics in SDKs; bump python-sdk to v2.8.0, typescript-sdk to v1.27.0, go-sdk to v1.4.2. Note: feature is opt-in and disabled for existing customers by default.
notes_for_backport: No backports required for security fixes; if backporting to release branches, ensure the retry DSL compile artifacts in sdk/common/retry_presets.json are included and the opt-in flag is documented.
